commits.subject: core: fixed # and // inside quoted JOP DSL values treated as comments
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

files.patch:
@@ -6749,7 +6749,8 @@ procedure TPreproc.DoRegister(m: TPreprocMarker; k, v, ve: PUtf8Char; kl: PtrInt
   repeat
     beg := v;
     while (v < ve) and (v^ <> '$') do
-      if ((v^ = '#') or
+      if (m = pmTemplate) and
+         ((v^ = '#') or
           (cardinal(PWord(v)^) = SLASH_16)) and
          ((v = beg) or (v[-1] <= ' ')) then
         break

@@ -1270,6 +1270,26 @@ procedure TTestCoreProcess.TestJopProcess;
     CheckEqual(TextPreprocess(
       'before $(missing|$(also)'),
       'before ');
+    // # and // inside quoted DSL values are not treated as comments
+    TestJop(
+      '$$'#10 +
+      'message = "hello # world"'#10 +
+      '$$'#10 +
+      '{value:$(message)}',
+      '{value:"hello # world"}');
+    TestJop(
+      '$$'#10 +
+      'message = "hello // world"'#10 +
+      '$$'#10 +
+      '{value:$(message)}',
+      '{value:"hello // world"}');
+    TestJop(
+      '$$'#10 +
+      'name = "hello"'#10 +
+      'message = "$(name)#tag"'#10 +
+      '$$'#10 +
+      '{value:$(message)}',
+      '{value:"hello#tag"}');
     // P0 #2: recursive includes
     mainFile   := WorkDir + 'jop-test-main.jop';
     outerFile  := WorkDir + 'jop-test-outer.jop';
